theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht
    case left.choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t', .choiceL ht', .bisim h'⟩
    case right.choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t', .choiceL ht', .bisim h'⟩
    all_goals exact ⟨s', .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t', ht', .bisim h'⟩
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t', ht', .bisim h'⟩

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht
    case left.choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t', .choiceL ht', .bisim h'⟩
    case right.choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t', .choiceL ht', .bisim h'⟩
    all_goals
      rename_i ht
      exact ⟨s', .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    have hm := Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ
    grind only [ChoiceBisim.bisim]

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by

    first

        grind only [lts, Tr.choiceL, Tr.choiceR, ChoiceBisim.bisim, HomBisimilarity.refl]

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  cases hr <;> rename_i h <;>
    refine (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp ?_ ?_ <;> intro hf s' ht
  all_goals
    first

    | cases ht with

        exact (hf _ ht).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL ChoiceBisim.bisim
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s', .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h

    refine (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp ?_ ?_ <;> intro hf s' ht
  case choice | choice =>

  all_goals exact (hf s' ht).imp fun _ => And.imp_right ChoiceBisim.bisim

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro s t (h | h) μ <;>
    apply (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp <;> intro hf s' ht
  case' choice | choice => cases ht
  case choiceR | choiceR => use s', Tr.choiceR ‹_›, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)
  all_goals exact (hf _ ‹_›).imp fun _ => And.imp (by
    try exact Tr.choiceL
    all_goals exact id) ChoiceBisim.bisim

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro s t (h | h) μ <;>
    apply (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp <;> intro hf s' ht
  case' choice | choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choiceR | choiceR => exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals exact (hf _ ht).imp fun _ => And.imp (by
    try exact id
    all_goals exact Tr.choiceL) ChoiceBisim.bisim
